test-process-env-tz.js: Date's local time zone is the browser's, fixed for the page by its JS engine; setting process.env.TZ can't change it at runtime (Node calls tzset() and tells V8 to re-detect it).
test-process-timeout.js: --process-timeout (new in Node 26) has to interrupt a thread that is running JavaScript and list libuv's handles from outside it; a Web Worker can't be interrupted from another thread without being terminated, so the option isn't implemented.
test-process-timeout-coverage.js: --process-timeout (new in Node 26) is not implemented: see test-process-timeout.js.
test-process-timeout-inspector.js: --process-timeout (new in Node 26) is not implemented, and the inspector isn't available: see test-process-timeout.js.
